topology: 1 node x4 H100, NVSHMEM put-ring, BOTH providers in one process
why: regression test for provider coexistence (7a5b55a): ib + gpumem loaded into ONE process, both writing into ONE capture. Same workload/topology as 04, the only variable is the second provider — so a coexistence regression shows up here and nowhere else.
scope_note: single-node, so NVSHMEM never posts an IB send (every peer is NVLink-reachable): the ib side contributes entities (MR/QP/modify_qp), not traffic. Cross-transport TRAFFIC correlation needs 2 nodes — see 07_nvshmem_multinode.
workload_note: identical to case 04 by construction — `putget 65536 3` on 4 PEs — because the only variable this case changes is the second provider. Both cases assert the same derivation against the same oracle, which is what makes the comparison between them evidence rather than coincidence.

expect_fail_asserts.entity_close_accounted: LIVE GAP, found by this assertion on its first run (MN5 job 44358674). Closes name entities no open record created: ~47 of 290 closes per rank on case 02, with 120 mr and 102 qp opens. A subset, not everything, so the close hooks are right and a REGISTRATION door is missing. Identified from source, not guessed: NCCL calls ibv_reg_dmabuf_mr (reference/nccl-git src/misc/ibvsymbols.cc:43, src/transport/net_ib/reg.cc:35) and NVSHMEM calls it too (reference/nvshmem-3.7.2-0 src/modules/transport/common/transport_ib_common.cpp:921). We hook ibv_reg_mr_iova2 and not that. The pattern matches exactly: cases 01 and 08 (pingpong, perftest) use the plain path and PASS; 02, 06 and 07 (NCCL, NVSHMEM) use dmabuf and fail. So dmabuf-registered memory regions are invisible entirely, not merely unclosed. The fix is NOT just adding the hook: registration_has_object requires a mem_object per region, and a dmabuf MR's address is only sometimes knowable — NCCL passes iova=addr at reg.cc:35 but iova=0 at gdaki/gin_host_gdaki.cc:131. Emitting a base-0 object would be the fiction mlx5dv already refuses for the same reason. See plans/PLAN-20260806-dmabuf-registered-regions. Do not weaken this assertion: it is doing exactly what it was written to do.
